about: Every lab funder found online, listed until Brian Funt confirms which to keep (set draft to false then). Sources, checked 2026-11-19: Crossref funder records on his papers (papers lists the DOIs that credit each funder; the grant number is from doi:10.3390/s20154275) and the lab's old funding page (oldPage, last updated January 15, 2007). Funders that Crossref lists for co-authors only (Apple, EPSRC, Chinese national programmes) are left out. Neither his ORCID record nor Alexander Forsythe's lists funding. The Digital Research Alliance of Canada entry is inferred from the mmb-zonotope-tiling README, whose Slurm settings use the accounts def-funt_gpu and def-funt_cpu (the Alliance's naming for a researcher's default allocation); to be confirmed.
